goal: Promote seven additional MNP providers to current exact/current-scope-limited records and introduce an explicit SolQvia real-account observation layer for LinksMate without conflating user-observed behavior with provider SLAs.
key_results: NifMo: current official 1-2 day issuance, 15-day validity, and data/SMS ineligibility are structured.
OCN Mobile ONE: 3-business-day issuance, 15-day validity, current one-stop flow and existing-number boundary are structured.
J:COM MOBILE: current public MNP information is rechecked, but source-side outbound issue timing/route remains explicitly unknown rather than inferred.
QT Mobile: 14-day validity, D type 2-5 days, A/S next-day-or-later, web free / phone 1,100 yen, and current two-stop-only rule are structured.
LinksMate: official next-day 09:00 eligibility, same-group one-at-a-time rule, and cross-group parallel rule are structured.
LinksMate: user-observed same-day issuance after next-day eligibility is stored only as SolQvia real-account observation, not as an official SLA.
y.u mobile: up-to-two-day issuance, 15-day validity, payment-method blocker and auto-cancel behavior are structured.
LIBMO: issuance is corrected to the current governing-term rule: earliest next business day, excluding weekends/holidays/long holiday periods; issue time cannot be specified.
evidence_policy: Official provider rules remain the authoritative specification layer.
SolQvia real-account observations are stored separately with date, scope and limitations.
An observation is not generalized into a provider-wide SLA unless official evidence confirms it.
Scope-limited current records keep unknown fields unknown rather than filling them with inference.
Where LIBMO notice pages and governing terms differ, SolQvia prioritizes the standing Important Matters document for issuance timing and records the wording conflict.
next_step: Phase174: currentize the next legacy MNP cohort based on search value and official-source availability, while prioritizing providers with distinctive blocker/reissue behavior and preserving current-vs-observed evidence layers.
